report.summary: Patient P-D010 (Gregory Nowak, 55, commercial PPO, no transport benefit, home tract 17031100500) was seen today V-D010. Screener (2026-10-21) shows no current utility shutoff concern and a transportation need flagged. Tract has low carless share (3.6%) but only one transit stop within 800m and one early-service stop. Utilities options: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (walk-in Tuesdays), Lakeside Energy Assistance (eligibility verified eligible via API), Neighborhood Energy Help (income-based, apply Mon/Wed in person). Transport options: Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification, up to 21 days) is the viable route; Medicaid Ride Line and Senior Shuttle West are not eligible (commercial insurance, age 55). Only recent appointment (appt:2) was today and kept, so no pending transit trip to verify.
